book.name: Matiu
book.title: Ka Maroyow no Nangnangonon no Insulat ni Matiu Bahin ki Hisu Kristu

content: Nootawan on si Hisus

To tapus to Allow ran to Oghimoloy no magaan on ogkapawo ka allow to Dominggu nighondio to pilang no sabalanan si Maria Magdalina woy ka duma rin no songo oghingaranan ki Maria oyow ogpitawon dan ka sabalanan.
Nò, duon maagbot no dinug woy duon diwata to Magboboot no niglogsad ligkat dio to langit. Niglilid din ka dakol no batu no in-atang dio to pilang woy nigpinnuuan din soini.
Malayag lagboy ka langlanguwan din no ogkounawa to kilat woy maputi lagboy ka kinabo din.
Ka mgo sundalu no nigbantoy, nahallok lagboy sikandan. Nigkolkol sikandan woy inat to namatoy sikandan.
Di atag nignangon ka diwata to Magboboot to mgo boi to, “Kono kow ogkahallok. Nataga a no ogpamitawon now si Hisus no inlansang dan dio to krus.
Warad on sikandin kai, su nootawan on, unawa to innangon din kaniu nokani. Hondini kow; pitawa now ka nohibatan din.”

Pogpitow to mgo boi ka noibatan ni Hisus, nigkagi ka diwata to, “Paragas kow oghondio to mgo hibatoon din woy nangoni now sikandan no nouyag on sikandin woy oghun-a on sikandin kaniu dio to Galilia. Dio now ogkitoon sikandin. Kono now ian kalingawi ka innangon ku kaniu,” kagi rin.
Nò, niglibuwas ka mgo boi to sika pilang no nigpallaguy. Nahallok ian sikandan, di songo lagboy no ogkarago. Nigpallaguy sikandan su ognangonan dan ka mgo hibatoon ni Hisus.
No, natokow no nigdani si Hisus kandan. Kagi rin to, “Hondoi kow?” Nigdanian dan si Hisus woy niggongonan dan ka paa rin no nigsayo dan sikandin.
“Kono kow ian ogkahallok,” kagi ni Hisus, “Hondio kow to mgo hibatoon ku woy nangoni now to oghondio sikandan to Galilia. Dia a ran ogkitaa.”
Ka mgo Ubat to mgo Ogbantoy to Sabalanan

Nò, to nokohipanow on ka mgo boi, songo nighipanow ka duma no mgo sundalu no nigbantoy to pilang. Nighondio sikandan to lunsud woy nignangonan dan ka mgo igbuyag to mgo talagpanubad to tibo no nohimuan.
Nò, niglibulung ka mgo igbuyag to mgo talagpanubad woy ka mgo tahuronon to mgo Hudiu no nigmoin-insooy sikandan ko nokoy ka oghimuon dan. Nò, nigbogayan dan ka sika mgo sundalu to dakol no salapi
woy nigsugu to, “Nangoni now ka mgo otow, to marusilom no nohirogo kow, nighondio ka mgo hibatoon ni Hisus woy nigtakow ran ka lawa rin.
Ko ogdinogon to gobirnador ka sika kagi, kanami on ka og-al-alukuy kandin oyow kono kow ogpabaybayaran nikandin.”
Nò, nigpurut to mgo sundalu ka salapi no nigpaagad-agad to insugu kandan. Nò, agad kuntoon no mgo allow, sikan pad ian ka nigtuuan to mgo Hudiu.
Nigpakita si Hisus to mgo Hibatoon din
Nò sika sampulu woy sagboka no hibatoon ni Hisus nighondio sikandan to Galilia. Nighondio ian sikandan to bubungan no innangon nokani ni Hisus kandan.
To pogkita ran ki Hisus, woy agad duon mgo duma ran no nigduwa-ruwa to nootawan to kamatayon din, nigsayo dan sikandin to nakitaan dan sikandin.
Nignangon si Hisus to, “Imbogoy koddi ka tibo no katondanan to langit woy to kalibutan.
Omunaan no, manhipanow kow dio to tibo no koot-otawan woy himua now no hibatoon ku sikandan.
Bautismui now sikandan to ngaran to Magboboot no Amoy woy to Anak din woy to Gimukud din
Anara now ka mgo otow oyow ogpaagad-agad sikandan to tibo no insugu ku kaniu. Woy kono now kalingawi no allow allow no ungod a ogdumaruma kaniu,
agad taman to poglibong ku.”

footnotes.text: Basa ka to Deuteronomio 31:6;1 Mga Hari 8:57; Hageo 1:13.
